 VoteMenu={Label="Votação",Gamepad="DPadDown",Keyboard="M"},

}
for _,action in {"MenuPrevious","MenuNext","GetOutCrawl","GetOutAttack","GetOutDrop","GetOutCheck","GetOutHacker"} do table.insert(Controls.Order,action) end
-- ButtonSelect is reserved for Roblox UI selection; it did not dispatch Jump in Studio.
Controls.GamepadKeys={"ButtonA","ButtonB","ButtonX","ButtonY","ButtonL1","ButtonR1","ButtonL2","ButtonR2","ButtonL3","ButtonR3","DPadLeft","DPadRight","DPadUp","DPadDown"}
function Controls:Attribute(action,device) return "Bind"..action..device end
function Controls:Conflicts(first,second) return Policy.Conflicts(first,second) end
function Controls:IsAllowed(device,name,action)
 if type(name)~="string" or not self.Actions[action] or (device~="Keyboard" and device~="Gamepad") then return false end
 if device=="Gamepad" then
  if (action=="MenuPrevious" or action=="MenuNext") and table.find({"ButtonA","ButtonB","DPadUp","DPadDown","DPadLeft","DPadRight"},name) then return false end
  return table.find(self.GamepadKeys,name)~=nil
 end
 if name=="MouseButton1" or name=="MouseButton2" or name=="MouseButton3" then return true end
 local ok,key=pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
 if not ok or not key or key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return false end
 if name:match("^Button") or name:match("^DPad") or name:match("^Thumbstick") then return false end
 if table.find({"Escape","Tab","One","Two","Backquote","Return","KeypadEnter","Up","Down","Left","Right"},name) then return false end
 return not table.find({"W","A","S","D","Space"},name) or name=="Space" and (action=="Jump" or action=="GetOutCheck")
end
function Controls:Input(name)
 if name:match("^MouseButton") then return Enum.UserInputType[name] end
 return Enum.KeyCode[name]
end
return Controls

local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer

Router:Register("Sprint",function(state) if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then toggle:FireServer() end end,{touch=true,title="CORRER",position=UDim2.fromScale(.57,.65)})
local held=false local bufferedUntil=0
local function requestJump()
 if Router:IsBlocked() then held=false bufferedUntil=0 return end
 local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not h or h.Health<=0 or not h:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) then return end
 h.Jump=true
 local state=h:GetState()
 if h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and state~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and state~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
  h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
 end
end
Router:Register("Jump",function(state)
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then held=true bufferedUntil=os.clock()+.18 requestJump()
 elseif state==Enum.UserInputState.End or state==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
  held=false
  local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then h.Jump=false end
 end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end)
-- Runs after PlayerModule has processed its own (consumed) gamepad input.

 if Router:IsBlocked() then held=false bufferedUntil=0 return end
 if held or os.clock()<bufferedUntil then requestJump() end
end)

local Assist={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players") local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local Scope=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModeScope")) local Mode=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("InputMode"))
local Math=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.AimAssist)
local models=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}) local refreshed=-100 local candidates={}
local state=Math.NewState()
local function track(item) if item:IsA("Humanoid") and item.Parent:IsA("Model") then models[item.Parent]=item end end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(track) for _,item in workspace:GetDescendants() do track(item) end
function Assist:Reset()
 refreshed=-100 candidates={} Math.Reset(state)
 player:SetAttribute("AimAssistActive",false) player:SetAttribute("AimAssistFriction",1)
 player:SetAttribute("AimAssistRotation",Vector2.zero) player:SetAttribute("AimAssistDistance",0)
end
local function eligibility(model,h,ctf,now,world)
 local other=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) local team=player.Team
 local allied=ctf and team and ((other and other.Team==team) or model:GetAttribute("CTFTeam")==team.Name)
 local protected=math.max(model:GetAttribute("SpawnProtectedUntil") or 0,model:GetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil") or 0)>now
 return Math.Eligible({mode=Scope:Get(),health=h.Health,allied=allied,protected=protected,
  shooterActive=player:GetAttribute(ctf and "InArena" or "ArenaPlaying"),
  targetActive=other and other:GetAttribute(ctf and "InArena" or "ArenaPlaying"),
  targetBot=model:GetAttribute("CTFBot"),
  targetTraining=world and model:IsDescendantOf(world) and model:GetAttribute("ArenaTarget")}),allied
end
function Assist:Target(view,point,camera,range,enabled,strength,firearm,viewmodel,aiming,context)
 local input=Mode:Get()
 if not enabled or strength<=0 or not firearm or not Scope:IsCombat() or input~=Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad and input~=Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then self:Reset() return nil,1,Vector2.zero end
 if os.clock()-refreshed>.08 then
  refreshed=os.clock() candidates={}
  for model,h in models do
   if model.Parent and h.Parent and model~=player.Character then
    local body=model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or body
    if body and root then table.insert(candidates,{id=model,body=body,root=root,humanoid=h}) end
   end
  end
 end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() local ctf=Scope:IsCTF() local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("CrossgroundsArenaRound")
 local ignore={}
 if player.Character then table.insert(ignore,player.Character) end if viewmodel then table.insert(ignore,viewmodel) end
 local active={}
 for _,entry in candidates do
  local h=entry.humanoid local model=entry.id
  if model.Parent and h.Parent and entry.body.Parent and entry.root.Parent then
   local eligible,allied=eligibility(model,h,ctf,now,world)

-- Input assistance only: no shot redirection, snap-to-target or head preference.
local Assist={}
Assist.Tuning=table.freeze({
 MaxRange=150,FrictionFadeStart=50,TrackingFadeStart=40,TrackingRange=100,
 NearStart=2,NearFull=12,Reaction=.09,Ramp=.10,PaddingHip=1.15,PaddingADS=.8,
 MaxSlowdown=.5,TrackingFraction=.60,MaxYawRate=90,MaxPitchRate=30,
})
local function smooth(a,b,value)
 local t=math.clamp((value-a)/math.max(.000001,b-a),0,1) return t*t*(3-2*t)
end
local function wrap(a) return (a+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi end
local function angles(delta)
 return Vector2.new(math.atan2(-delta.X,-delta.Z),math.asin(math.clamp(delta.Unit.Y,-1,1)))
end
function Assist.Eligible(state)
 if state.health<=0 or state.allied or state.protected or not state.shooterActive then return false end
 if state.mode=="ctf" then return state.targetActive or state.targetBot or false end
 if state.mode=="arena" then return state.targetActive or state.targetTraining or false end
 return false
end
function Assist.Distance(distance)
 local t=Assist.Tuning
 local near=.45+.55*smooth(t.NearStart,t.NearFull,distance)
 return near*(1-smooth(t.FrictionFadeStart,t.MaxRange,distance)),near*(1-smooth(t.TrackingFadeStart,t.TrackingRange,distance))
end
function Assist.Window(origin,direction,candidate,aiming,range)
 if direction.Magnitude<.001 then return end
 local frame=candidate.frame or CFrame.new(candidate.point)
 local center=frame.Position local delta=center-origin local distance=delta.Magnitude
 if distance<1.25 or distance>math.min(range or Assist.Tuning.MaxRange,Assist.Tuning.MaxRange) then return end
 local unit=direction.Unit local along=delta:Dot(unit) if along<=0 then return end
 local size=candidate.size or Vector3.new(2.8,5,2)
 local half=size*.5
 local rayPoint=frame:PointToObjectSpace(origin+unit*along)
 local localPoint=Vector3.new(math.clamp(rayPoint.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(rayPoint.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(rayPoint.Z,-half.Z,half.Z))
 local point=frame:PointToWorldSpace(localPoint)
 local edge=math.acos(math.clamp(unit:Dot((point-origin).Unit),-1,1))
 local padding=math.rad(aiming and Assist.Tuning.PaddingADS or Assist.Tuning.PaddingHip)
 if edge>padding then return end
 local error=angles(point-origin)-angles(unit) error=Vector2.new(wrap(error.X),error.Y)
 return {candidate=candidate,center=center,point=point,distance=distance,weight=1-smooth(0,padding,edge),edge=edge,error=error,onBody=edge<.0001}
end
function Assist.Select(origin,direction,candidates,visible,range,aiming,previous)
 local selected,best=nil,math.huge
 for _,candidate in candidates do
  local window=Assist.Window(origin,direction,candidate,aiming,range)
  if window then
   local centerAngle=math.acos(math.clamp(direction.Unit:Dot((window.center-origin).Unit),-1,1))
   local score=window.edge*4+centerAngle*.15
   if candidate.id==previous then score-=math.rad(.25) end
   if score<best and visible(candidate,origin,window.point) then selected=window best=score end
  end
 end
 return selected
end
function Assist.NewState() return {friction=1,age=0,velocity=Vector2.zero} end
function Assist.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state) state.friction=1 state.age=0 state.velocity=Vector2.zero
end
function Assist.Step(state,window,context)
 local dt=context.dt or 0 local strength=math.clamp(context.strength or 0,0,1)
 if not window or strength<=0 or dt<=0 or dt>.075 then Assist.Reset(state) return 1,Vector2.zero end
 local input=context.look or Vector2.zero
 local magnitude=math.min(1,input.Magnitude)
 local frictionRange,trackingRange=Assist.Distance(window.distance)
 local escape=1-.9*smooth(.7,1,magnitude)
 if window.error.Magnitude>.0001 and input.Magnitude>.025 and input.Unit:Dot(window.error.Unit)<-.1 then escape*=.15 end
 local slowdown=math.clamp(context.slowdown or 1,0,1)
 local goal=1-Assist.Tuning.MaxSlowdown*strength*slowdown*window.weight*frictionRange*escape
 local response=goal>state.friction and .025 or .055
 state.friction+=(goal-state.friction)*(1-math.exp(-dt/response))
 local origin=context.origin
 local same=state.target==window.candidate.id and state.anchor~=nil
 local previousOrigin,previousAnchor,previousCenter=state.origin,state.anchor,state.center
 state.target=window.candidate.id state.origin=origin state.anchor=window.point state.center=window.center
 if not same then state.age=0 state.velocity=Vector2.zero return state.friction,Vector2.zero end
 state.age+=dt
 local targetMove=window.center-previousCenter local selfMove=origin-previousOrigin
 if targetMove.Magnitude/dt>80 or selfMove.Magnitude/dt>110 then
  state.age=0 state.velocity=Vector2.zero return state.friction,Vector2.zero
 end
 -- Use translation of the last player-chosen body anchor. Manual look and rig rotation
 -- do not become target velocity, so they cannot create attraction to a body center.
 local before=previousAnchor-previousOrigin local after=previousAnchor+targetMove-origin
 if before.Magnitude<.1 or after.Magnitude<.1 then return state.friction,Vector2.zero end
 local a,b=angles(before),angles(after)
 local velocity=Vector2.new(wrap(b.X-a.X),b.Y-a.Y)/dt
 if velocity.Magnitude<.0001 then state.velocity=Vector2.zero return state.friction,Vector2.zero end
 state.velocity=state.velocity:Lerp(velocity,1-math.exp(-dt/.065))
 if state.velocity.Magnitude<.0001 then return state.friction,Vector2.zero end
 local gate=0
 if magnitude>.025 then
  local alignment=math.max(0,input.Unit:Dot(state.velocity.Unit))
  gate=alignment*smooth(.025,.15,magnitude)
 elseif context.device=="gamepad" then
  gate=.14*smooth(.15,.75,math.abs(context.strafe or 0))
 end
 if state.age<Assist.Tuning.Reaction then return state.friction,Vector2.zero end
 local ramp=smooth(Assist.Tuning.Reaction,Assist.Tuning.Reaction+Assist.Tuning.Ramp,state.age)
 local gain=Assist.Tuning.TrackingFraction*strength*math.clamp(context.tracking or 1,0,1)*trackingRange*window.weight^2*gate*escape*ramp
 local delta=state.velocity*dt*gain
 local yawLimit=math.rad(Assist.Tuning.MaxYawRate)*strength*trackingRange*dt
 local pitchLimit=math.rad(Assist.Tuning.MaxPitchRate)*strength*trackingRange*dt
 return state.friction,Vector2.new(math.clamp(delta.X,-yawLimit,yawLimit),math.clamp(delta.Y*.35,-pitchLimit,pitchLimit))
end
return Assist

-- Shared, deterministic control policy. No services: safe to exercise in isolation.
local Policy={}
local combat={"ctf","arena"}
local world={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin"}
Policy.Contexts={
 Fire=combat,Aim=combat,Sprint=combat,Perspective=combat,SwitchWeapon=combat,ShiftLock=combat,Shoulder=combat,
 Jump=combat,ReloadInteract={"ctf","survivor","beast"},
 Menu={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin","menu"},
 KitMenu={"ctf"},VoteMenu={"ctf","arena"},Leave={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting"},
 AdminMode=world,AdminSpeedUp={"admin"},AdminSpeedDown={"admin"},AdminPreviousMap={"admin"},AdminNextMap={"admin"},AdminClean={"admin"},
 GetOutCrawl={"survivor"},GetOutAttack={"beast"},GetOutDrop={"beast"},GetOutCheck={"hacking"},GetOutHacker={"beast"},
 MenuPrevious={"menu"},MenuNext={"menu"},
}
function Policy.Context(s)
 if s.modal then return "menu" end
 if s.admin then return "admin" end
 if s.mode=="get_out" then
  if not s.alive or s.result and s.result~="active" then return "waiting" end
  if s.role=="beast" then return "beast" end
  if s.role=="survivor" then return s.hacking and "hacking" or "survivor" end
  return "waiting"
 end
 return s.mode
end
function Policy.Conflicts(a,b)
 local first,second=Policy.Contexts[a],Policy.Contexts[b]
 if not first or not second then return true end
 for _,context in first do if table.find(second,context) then return true end end
 return false
end
function Policy.Available(action,s)
 if s.suspended then return false,"suspended" end
 local context=Policy.Context(s)
 if not table.find(Policy.Contexts[action] or {},context) then return false,"context:"..tostring(context) end
 if action:match("^Admin") and not s.authorized then return false,"permission" end
 if action=="Menu" and s.modal and not s.settingsMenu then return false,"another-menu" end
 if action=="AdminMode" and (s.inMatch or s.mode=="arena" and s.arenaPlaying) and not s.admin then return false,"in-match" end
 if action=="GetOutCrawl" and s.victim~="Active" and s.victim~="Crawling" then return false,"victim" end
 if action=="GetOutDrop" and not s.dragging then return false,"no-victim" end
 if context=="ctf" or context=="arena" then
  if action~="Menu" and action~="KitMenu" and action~="VoteMenu" and action~="Leave" and action~="AdminMode" then
   if not s.alive or s.spectating or context=="ctf" and not s.inMatch or context=="arena" and not s.arenaPlaying then return false,"inactive" end
  end
 end
 return true
end
function Policy.Resolve(actions,s)
 local winner
 for _,action in actions do
  if Policy.Available(action,s) and (not winner or Policy.Priority(action)>Policy.Priority(winner) or Policy.Priority(action)==Policy.Priority(winner) and action<winner) then winner=action end
 end
 return winner
end
function Policy.Priority(action)
 if action=="MenuPrevious" or action=="MenuNext" then return 800 end
 if action=="Menu" then return 700 end
 if action=="AdminMode" then return 600 end
 if action:match("^Admin") then return 500 end
 return 100
end
-- Reassign every overlapping action, then verify the entire graph before committing.
-- Incompatible legacy profiles fail without partially changing any binding.
function Policy.Plan(definitions,bindings,action,device,name)
 if not definitions.Actions[action] or not definitions:IsAllowed(device,name,action) then return nil,"invalid" end
 local plan=table.clone(bindings) local old=plan[action] plan[action]=name
 local affected={[action]=true}
 for other in definitions.Actions do
  if other~=action and Policy.Conflicts(action,other) and plan[other]==name then
   if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,old,other) then return nil,"reserved" end
   plan[other]=old affected[other]=true
  end
 end
 for first in definitions.Actions do
  for second in definitions.Actions do
   if first<second and (affected[first] or affected[second]) and plan[first]==plan[second] and Policy.Conflicts(first,second) then return nil,"conflict" end
  end
 end
 return plan
end
function Policy.Normalize(definitions,bindings,device)
 local result={} local order={}
 for action in definitions.Actions do table.insert(order,action) end
 table.sort(order,function(a,b) local x,y=Policy.Priority(a),Policy.Priority(b) return x==y and a<b or x>y end)
 local function free(action,key)
  if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,key,action) then return false end
  for other,value in result do if value==key and Policy.Conflicts(action,other) then return false end end
  return true
 end
 for _,action in order do
  local key=bindings[action]
  if not free(action,key) then
   local candidates={definitions.Actions[action][device]}
   if device=="Gamepad" then for _,value in definitions.GamepadKeys do table.insert(candidates,value) end
   else for _,value in {"F8","F9","F10","F11","F12","Z","X","C","B","N","H","J","U","I","O","P","T","Y","Equals","Minus","LeftBracket","RightBracket"} do table.insert(candidates,value) end end
   key=nil for _,candidate in candidates do if free(action,candidate) then key=candidate break end end
  end
  if not key then return nil,"no-free-binding:"..action end
  result[action]=key
 end
 return result
end
return Policy

local Reload=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponReloadMotion)
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local function safePart(p)
 p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
end
function Renderer.new(tool)

 local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name="FirstPersonDisplay" gui.DisplayOrder=-10 gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true gui.ResetOnSpawn=false gui.Parent=player.PlayerGui self.gui=gui
 local viewport=Instance.new("ViewportFrame") viewport.Name="WeaponViewport" viewport.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) viewport.BackgroundTransparency=1 viewport.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(170,180,190) viewport.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,223) viewport.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-2,-3) viewport.Parent=gui self.viewport=viewport
 local camera=Instance.new("Camera") camera.CFrame=CFrame.new() camera.FieldOfView=70 camera.Parent=viewport viewport.CurrentCamera=camera self.camera=camera
 local world=Instance.new("WorldModel") world.Parent=viewport
 local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name="FirstPersonWeapon" model.Parent=world self.Model=model
 local original=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") if not original then self:Destroy() return end
 for _,v in tool:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("BasePart") then

 end end
 local handle=model:FindFirstChild("Handle") model.PrimaryPart=handle
 model:ScaleTo(tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")=="ArenaPistol" and .9 or tool:GetAttribute("WeaponKind")=="Gun" and .72 or .65)
 for _,p in model:GetChildren() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(self.parts,{part=p,rest=p.CFrame,group=p:GetAttribute("ReloadGroup"),reloadOnly=p:GetAttribute("ReloadOnly")}) end end

 local humanoid=Instance.new("Humanoid") humanoid.RequiresNeck=false humanoid.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None humanoid.Parent=skin
 local character=player.Character
 for _,class in {"Shirt","BodyColors"} do local v=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(class) if v then v:Clone().Parent=skin end end
 local function part(name,size,color)
  local p=Instance.new("Part") p.Name=name p.Size=size p.Color=color p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic safePart(p) p.Parent=skin return p
 end
 for _,name in {"Torso","Head","Left Leg","Right Leg","HumanoidRootPart"} do local p=part(name,Vector3.one,Color3.new()) p.Transparency=1 end
 for _,side in {"Right","Left"} do
  local source=character and (character:FindFirstChild(side.." Arm") or character:FindFirstChild(side.."UpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild(side.."LowerArm"))
  local color=source and source.Color or Color3.fromRGB(234,184,146)
  local arm=part(side.." Arm",Vector3.new(.43,1.5,.46),color)
  -- Classic shirt is applied by the R6-named parts; source meshes are intentionally absent.
  local grip=handle:FindFirstChild(side=="Right" and "RightHandGrip" or "SupportGrip")
  if grip then table.insert(self.arms,{part=arm,side=side,hand=grip.Position}) else arm.Transparency=1 end
 end
 local flash=Instance.new("Part") flash.Name="MuzzleFlash" flash.Size=Vector3.new(.18,.18,.55) flash.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,222,123) flash.Material=Enum.Material.Neon flash.Transparency=1 safePart(flash) flash.Parent=model self.flash=flash
 return self
end
function Renderer:SetVisible(on) if self.gui then self.gui.Enabled=on end end
function Renderer:Flash() self.flashUntil=os.clock()+.045 end
function Renderer:Render(dt,camera,character,params)
 self:SetVisible(true)
 self.lightElapsed=(self.lightElapsed or 0)+dt
 if self.lightElapsed>.15 then
  self.lightElapsed=0 self.ambient,self.sunTint,self.sunDirection=Probe.Sample(camera,character)
 end
 if self.ambient then self.viewport.Ambient=self.ambient self.viewport.LightColor=self.sunTint end
 self.viewport.LightDirection=camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(-game.Lighting:GetSunDirection())
 local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position,camera.CFrame.LookVector*3,rp)
 local proximity=hit and math.clamp((2.4-hit.Distance)/1.6,0,1) or 0
 self.wall+=(proximity-self.wall)*(1-math.exp(-dt*13))
 local reloading=self.tool:GetAttribute("Reloading")
 local duration=self.tool:GetAttribute("ReloadDuration") or .9
 local t=reloading and math.clamp((workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(self.tool:GetAttribute("ReloadStartedAt") or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))/duration,0,1) or 0
 local reload=Reload.Sample(t,self.tool:GetAttribute("CosmeticId") or self.tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId"))
 local pistol=self.tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")=="ArenaPistol" local gun=self.tool:GetAttribute("WeaponKind")=="Gun"
 local lower=pistol and -.65 or gun and -.85 or -1.1
 local base=CFrame.new(pistol and .55 or .65,lower,pistol and -1.7 or -2.1)
 local arc=params.arc or 0
 local cf=base*(params.runPose or CFrame.new())*reload.weapon*CFrame.new(-arc*.7,self.wall*.12-arc*.35,self.wall*.45+(params.recoil or 0))*CFrame.Angles(math.rad((params.pitch or 0)+self.wall*55-arc*65),0,math.rad((params.roll or 0)-arc*55))
 for _,entry in self.parts do
  local transform=entry.group=="Magazine" and reload.magazine or entry.group=="Cylinder" and reload.cylinder or entry.group=="Slide" and reload.slide or entry.group=="Toggle" and reload.toggle or entry.group=="BreakAction" and reload.breakAction or entry.group=="Shell" and reload.breakAction*reload.shell or entry.group=="TubeShell" and reload.tubeShell or CFrame.new()
  entry.part.CFrame=cf*transform*entry.rest
  if entry.reloadOnly then entry.part.Transparency=reload.active>.02 and 0 or 1 end
 end
 for _,arm in self.arms do
  local side=arm.side=="Right" and 1 or -1
  local hand=arm.hand+(side<0 and reload.hand or Vector3.zero)
  local elbow=Vector3.new(side*(.9+(.18+.36*math.sin(params.runPhase or 0))*(params.runWeight or 0)),-.65,1.25)
  local a=cf:PointToWorldSpace(hand) local b=cf:PointToWorldSpace(elbow*self.scale)
  arm.part.Size=Vector3.new(.43,(a-b).Magnitude,.46)
  arm.part.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((a+b)*.5,a)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
 end
 local muzzle=self.handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
 if muzzle then
  self.flash.CFrame=muzzle.WorldCFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-.2)
  self.flash.Transparency=os.clock()<self.flashUntil and .1 or 1
 end
 player:SetAttribute("WeaponWallRaise",self.wall) player:SetAttribute("WeaponRenderer","ViewportFrame")
end
function Renderer:ShotOrigin(worldCamera)
 local muzzle=self.handle and self.handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") if not muzzle then return end
 local p=self.camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(muzzle.WorldPosition) local depth=-p.Z
 if depth<=.1 then return end
 local v=worldCamera.ViewportSize local tan=math.tan(math.rad(self.camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local x=.5+p.X/(depth*2*tan*v.X/math.max(1,v.Y)) local y=.5-p.Y/(depth*2*tan)
 local ray=worldCamera:ViewportPointToRay(x*v.X,y*v.Y)
 return worldCamera.CFrame.Position+ray.Direction*math.min(depth,3)
end
function Renderer:Destroy() if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end self.gui=nil end
return Renderer

local Scope=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModeScope"))
local Router={}
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Definition=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ControlDefinitions"))
local Settings=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ExperienceSettings"))
local Icons=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("InputIcons"))
local update=game.ReplicatedStorage.Events:WaitForChild("UpdateExperienceSetting")
local listeners={} local capture local generation=0
local changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent") Router.Changed=changed.Event
local captureChanged=Instance.new("BindableEvent") Router.CaptureChanged=captureChanged.Event
function Router:Key(action,device)
 local key=Definition:Attribute(action,device)
 return player:GetAttribute("Setting"..key) or Definition.Actions[action][device]
end
local Policy=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ControlPolicy"))
local Gui=game:GetService("GuiService")
local focused=true
local owners={} local bindings={} local customContexts={}
local contextChanged=Instance.new("BindableEvent") Router.ContextChanged=contextChanged.Event
function Router:Snapshot()
 local p=player
 local join=p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JoinMenu") local hud=p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("CombatHUD")
 local modal=p:GetAttribute("GameMenuOpen")==true or p:GetAttribute("ExperienceMenuOpen")==true
  or p:GetAttribute("ProgressionMenuOpen")==true or p:GetAttribute("LobbyMusicMenuOpen")==true
  or p:GetAttribute("CTFKitMenuOpen")==true or p:GetAttribute("ArenaVotingOpen")==true
  or p:GetAttribute("HUDLayoutEditing")==true or p:GetAttribute("InventoryOpen")==true
  or p:GetAttribute("InventoryMenuOpen")==true or Scope:IsCTF() and
   (join and join.Enabled or hud and hud.Enabled and hud:FindFirstChild("LeaveShade") and hud.LeaveShade.Visible)
 for _,provider in customContexts do if provider() then modal=true end end
 local h=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return {mode=Scope:Get(),modal=modal==true,settingsMenu=p:GetAttribute("ExperienceMenuOpen")==true,
  suspended=not focused or capture~=nil or p:GetAttribute("ClientLoading")==true or p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition")==true or Gui.MenuIsOpen or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil,
  admin=p:GetAttribute("AdminFreecam")==true,authorized=p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsAdmin")==true,
  inMatch=p:GetAttribute("InMatch")==true,arenaPlaying=p:GetAttribute("ArenaPlaying")==true,
  alive=h~=nil and h.Health>0,spectating=p:GetAttribute("SpectatingEliminator")==true,
  role=p:GetAttribute("GetOutRole"),result=p:GetAttribute("GetOutResult"),
  hacking=p:GetAttribute("GetOutHacking")==true,victim=p:GetAttribute("GetOutVictimState"),
  dragging=p:GetAttribute("ControlDragging")==true}
end
function Router:RegisterModal(id,provider)
 assert(type(id)=="string" and type(provider)=="function")
 customContexts[id]=provider
 return function() customContexts[id]=nil end
end
function Router:CanMove()
 local s=self:Snapshot()
 return not s.suspended and not s.modal and (s.admin or s.alive and not s.spectating and
  (s.mode~="arena" or s.arenaPlaying) and (s.mode~="get_out" or s.result==nil or s.result=="active"))
end
function Router:IsBlocked()
 local s=self:Snapshot()
 return s.suspended or s.modal or s.admin or s.spectating or not s.alive
  or not (Scope:IsCombat() or Scope:IsGetOut())
  or Scope:IsArena() and not s.arenaPlaying
  or Scope:IsCTF() and not s.inMatch
  or Scope:IsGetOut() and Policy.Context(s)=="waiting"
end
function Router:IsAvailable(action,snapshot)
 local registered=listeners[action]
 if not registered then return false end
 local s=snapshot or self:Snapshot()
 if not Policy.Available(action,s) then return false end
 local scope=registered.scope
 if scope=="admin" and not s.admin or scope=="get_out" and s.mode~="get_out"
  or scope=="ctf" and s.mode~="ctf" or scope=="combat" and not Scope:IsCombat()
  or scope=="interaction" and not Scope:IsInteractive() then return false end
 if registered.enabled and not registered.enabled(s) then return false end
 return true
end
local function cancelOwner(token,record)
 if record then record.callback(Enum.UserInputState.Cancel,record.input) end
 owners[token]=false -- Held keys cannot transfer to another context until released.
end
function Router:CancelAll()
 for token,record in owners do if record then cancelOwner(token,record) end end
end
function Router:Dispatch(action,state,input)
 local registered=listeners[action]
 if not registered then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 local token=input or ("touch:"..action)
 local record=owners[token]
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel or state==Enum.UserInputState.End then
  if record and record.action==action then
   owners[token]=nil return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
  end
  if record==false then owners[token]=nil return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end
 if not self:IsAvailable(action) then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not record then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and record~=nil then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
 local result=registered.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and result~=Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass then
  owners[token]={action=action,callback=registered.callback,input=input}
 end
 return result
end
local function route(name,state,input)
 local record=owners[input]
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.End or state==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
  if record then owners[input]=nil return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if record==false then owners[input]=nil return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end
 if record~=nil then
  if not record then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if not Router:IsAvailable(record.action) then cancelOwner(input,record) return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 end
 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 local s=Router:Snapshot() local candidates={}
 for action in listeners do
  if (Router:Key(action,"Keyboard")==name or Router:Key(action,"Gamepad")==name) and Router:IsAvailable(action,s) then table.insert(candidates,action) end
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) local x,y=Policy.Priority(a),Policy.Priority(b) return x==y and a<b or x>y end)
 for _,action in candidates do
  local result=Router:Dispatch(action,state,input)
  if result~=Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass then return result end
 end
 -- UI navigation owns its own keys at a higher priority. Swallow world buttons
 -- below it so Tool.Activated/native jump cannot leak through a modal.
 if s.modal or s.suspended then owners[input]=false return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end
local function bind()
 Router:CancelAll()
 for name in bindings do CAS:UnbindAction("CrossgroundsInput:"..name) end
 table.clear(bindings)
 for action in listeners do
  for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
   local name=Router:Key(action,device)
   if not bindings[name] then
    bindings[name]=true
    CAS:BindActionAtPriority("CrossgroundsInput:"..name,function(_,state,input)
     return route(name,state,input)
    end,false,5000,Definition:Input(name))
   end
  end
 end
end
function Router:Register(action,callback,options)
 assert(Definition.Actions[action],"Unknown control: "..tostring(action))
 local previous=listeners[action]
 if previous then
  for token,record in owners do if record and record.action==action then cancelOwner(token,record) end end
 end
 local registered=table.clone(options or {}) registered.callback=callback
 listeners[action]=registered bind()
end
local function reconcile()
 local s=Router:Snapshot()
 for token,record in owners do
  if record and not Router:IsAvailable(record.action,s) then cancelOwner(token,record) end
 end
 local context=s.suspended and "suspended" or Policy.Context(s)
 if Router.Context~=context then Router.Context=context contextChanged:Fire(context) end
end
UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() focused=false Router:CancelAll() end)
UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function() focused=true end)
UIS.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function() Router:CancelAll() end)
UIS.GamepadDisconnected:Connect(function() Router:CancelAll() end)
Gui.MenuOpened:Connect(function() Router:CancelAll() end)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() Router:CancelAll() end)
player.AttributeChanged:Connect(reconcile)
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(reconcile)
function Router:Commit(action,device,name)
 local current={} for id in Definition.Actions do current[id]=self:Key(id,device) end
 local plan,reason=Policy.Plan(Definition,current,action,device,name)
 if not plan then return false,reason end
 self:CancelAll()
 for id,value in plan do if value~=current[id] then player:SetAttribute("Setting"..Definition:Attribute(id,device),value) end end
 update:FireServer(Definition:Attribute(action,device),name)
 return true
end
local function finish(success,name)
 if not capture then return end
 local request=capture capture=nil player:SetAttribute("Rebinding",false)
 if success then success=Router:Commit(request.action,request.device,name) end
 captureChanged:Fire(false,success and "Controle atualizado. Atalhos em conflito foram trocados." or "Controle não aplicado. Conflito ou captura cancelada; o anterior foi mantido.")
 local completedGeneration=generation
 task.delay(.15,function() if not capture and generation==completedGeneration then CAS:UnbindAction("CTFCaptureBinding") end end)
end
function Router:Capture(action,device)
 if capture or not Definition.Actions[action] or (device~="Keyboard" and device~="Gamepad") then return end
 Router:CancelAll()
 generation+=1 local token=generation
 capture={action=action,device=device,ready=os.clock()+.2,deadline=os.clock()+5}
 player:SetAttribute("Rebinding",true)
 local inputs={Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3}
 for _,key in Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems() do if key~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then table.insert(inputs,key) end end
 CAS:BindActionAtPriority("CTFCaptureBinding",function(_,state,input)
  if not capture then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and os.clock()>=capture.ready then
   if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB and capture.device=="Keyboard" then finish(false) return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
   local name=input.KeyCode.Name
   if input.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton") then name=input.UserInputType.Name end
   if Definition:IsAllowed(capture.device,name,capture.action) then finish(true,name) end
  end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 end,false,10000,table.unpack(inputs))
 captureChanged:Fire(true,Definition.Actions[action].Label)
 task.delay(5,function() if token==generation then finish(false) end end)
end
function Router:CaptureRemaining() return capture and math.max(0,math.ceil(capture.deadline-os.clock())) or 0 end
function Router:Reset(deviceOnly)
 self:CancelAll()
 for action,data in pairs(Definition.Actions) do
  for _,device in {"Gamepad","Keyboard"} do if not deviceOnly or deviceOnly==device then player:SetAttribute("Setting"..Definition:Attribute(action,device),data[device]) end end
 end
 update:FireServer("ResetControls",deviceOnly or true)
end
for action in pairs(Definition.Actions) do
 for _,device in {"Gamepad","Keyboard"} do
  player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Setting"..Definition:Attribute(action,device)):Connect(function() bind() Icons:Refresh() changed:Fire() end)
 end
end
return Router

-- Cosmetic carry/run pose. This never changes speed, cooldown or aim direction.
local Motion={} Motion.__index=Motion
function Motion.new() return setmetatable({phase=0,weight=0,side=0},Motion) end
function Motion:Reset() self.phase=0 self.weight=0 self.side=0 end
function Motion:Update(dt,velocity,grounded,sprinting,aiming,firing,amount)
 dt=math.clamp(dt,0,.05) amount=math.clamp(amount or 0,0,1)
 local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
 local target=grounded and sprinting and speed>1 and not aiming and not firing and math.clamp(speed/25,0,1) or 0
 local alpha=1-math.exp(-dt*14) self.weight+=(target-self.weight)*alpha
 self.side+=(math.clamp(velocity.X/25,-1,1)-self.side)*alpha
 if speed>.6 and grounded then self.phase+=dt*(sprinting and 7 or 8)*math.clamp(speed/18,.25,1.4) end
 local w=self.weight*math.sqrt(amount) local wave=math.sin(self.phase) local step=math.cos(self.phase*2)
 local offset=Vector3.new(-.16*w+wave*.30*w,-.16*w+step*.075*w,.13*w)
 local rotation=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-18*w+step*2.5*w),math.rad(10*w),math.rad(-12*w+wave*7*w-self.side*2*amount))
 return CFrame.new(offset)*rotation,w,self.phase
end
return Motion
